name: kinetic-line-studies-v0
description: Original kinetic light sculptures: restrained palette, black space, broad coherent line motion.

softness.meaning: soft luminous edge width in normalized coordinates

clips.name: aperture
clips.description: Rounded rectangular light contours travel through a dark architectural opening with a small cyclic shear.

clips.name: fold
clips.description: An ivory ribbed light sheet bends through one slow travelling fold; an acid-green rib marks the direction.

clips.name: interference
clips.description: Two finite ivory line fields shear into broad moving interference bands against black; a restrained green edge carries tension.

selection_rationale: Lowest measured temporal complexity of the three original studies. Chosen as the first family; learnability remains a hypothesis until NCA training.
